title: Repo config
description: Where the repo's standing rules live, and extra files to protect during a build.

staticRules.description: Markdown files holding the repo's and workspace's standing rules, relative to the repo root or absolute, no globs. The cockpit shows them read-only; nexus never writes them.

protect.description: Extra files to protect during a build: globs relative to the repo root, starting with ~/, or absolute. Added to the defaults; a repo can't remove a default.
